picks.reasoning: TLAW's roster has been carrying the better individual talent, and Josedeodo's 7.6 KDA over 20 games says the jungle is driving the results. CFO's leads convert, but they have thrown two big leads this year and I don't trust a team that gives games back.

TLAW owns the early map: +1.1k at 15, 75% first towers, 65% first dragons, and 9/9 leads converted at 15, while CFO sits at -0.2k with only 35% first dragons. Tempo goes to TLAW, and CFO has to take fights from behind.

TLAW's deeper champion pool across Pantheon, Lucian, and Ahri/Orianna/Syndra gives them more flexibility to counter whatever CFO draft under Fearless, and their +1.1k GD@15 with 9/9 converted leads outpaces CFO's near-even early game. CFO's Akali and Lucian-heavy picks are dangerous, but their 35% first dragon rate and thin 12-14 international record leave them vulnerable to a draft-led TLAW game.

TLAW has the edge on the numbers: a 22-10 series record against CFO's 12-14, a +1.1k GD@15 over the last 20 games against CFO's -0.2k, and a 65% first dragon rate against 35%. Head-to-head data is absent, and CFO's 60% first blood rate and recent 7-3 form keep this from being a lopsided call.

TLAW's group looks settled: a 9-1 run on the last ten, a jungler who keeps the team steady, and a bench that doesn't rattle when games get long. CFO has the sharper mid-game swings, but they've thrown big leads twice, and that kind of shake tends to linger in a group's mood.
